items.title: Structural-Scale Controls on Evenly-Spaced Hydrothermal Mineralization and AI-Based Predictive Methods
items.what_changed: The study combines 3D discrete-element simulation with an MLP model to quantify structural spacing and test prediction of concealed mineralization.
items.why_it_matters: It is a useful example of coupling mechanical geological constraints with machine learning rather than treating prospectivity prediction as a purely statistical black box.
items.read_if: You work with structural targeting, concealed orebodies or prospectivity modelling.

items.title: Application of Modern Techniques in the Geochemical, Structural, and Remote Sensing Reassessment of Huyahuya and Antabamba
items.what_changed: An integrated reassessment of ANAP areas combines compositional geochemistry, fractal methods, remote-sensing indices and structural analysis; the authors report 14 additional target polygons beyond those previously proposed.
items.why_it_matters: This is directly relevant to regional targeting in southern Peru because it demonstrates a reproducible workflow that integrates geochemistry, alteration proxies and structure rather than ranking anomalies independently.
items.read_if: You work on Peru regional exploration, lithogeochemistry or multi-dataset targeting.

items.title: Mineral chemistry in exploration: A review of diamond, magmatic sulfide, IOA, IOCG, and porphyry systems
items.what_changed: The review synthesizes mineral-chemistry applications across several deposit families and emphasizes integration with complementary datasets and process-driven models.
items.why_it_matters: Mineral chemistry can provide vectoring resolution beyond bulk-rock geochemistry, but the review reinforces that the strongest exploration value comes from geological integration rather than standalone discrimination plots.
items.read_if: You are designing vectoring workflows or considering mineral chemistry/ML datasets.

items.title: Esperanza moves into first-ever drill testing in southern Peru
items.source_name: DLP Resources Inc. release via Newsfile
items.what_changed: DLP reports permits for a seven-hole ~3,000 m maiden program, including three deep holes targeting an interpreted porphyry core beneath a large magnetic anomaly.
items.why_it_matters: Maiden drilling of a large, previously untested target is a high-information event: the program will test whether coincident surface, geochemical and geophysical vectors translate into a mineralized porphyry system at depth.
items.read_if: You follow new porphyry tests and southern Peru exploration.
